# Test offline-safe static search generation.
#
# When -search is set, md2html must:
#   1. Emit search-index.js assigning window.MD2HTML_SEARCH_INDEX (so the
#      site works under file:// without fetch).
#   2. Copy the embedded minisearch.min.js and search.js into out/js/.
#   3. Reference assets via relative paths (./ at root, ../ from nested
#      pages) so opening any page directly via file:// loads search.

md2html -search -html out -html-ext html src

# All expected files exist.
exists out/index.html
exists out/README.html
exists out/sub/nested.html
! exists out/search-index.js
! exists out/js/minisearch.min.js
! exists out/js/search.js
exists out/js

# search-index.js assigns the global, not a JSON file.
exists out/search-index.27a14f92.js
exists out/js/minisearch.min.e66b5b61.js
exists out/js/search.99d69869.js
grep '^window\.MD2HTML_SEARCH_INDEX = \[' out/search-index.27a14f92.js
grep '"title":"README"' out/search-index.27a14f92.js
grep '"title":"Nested Page"' out/search-index.27a14f92.js

# Top-level page references assets with ./ prefix.
grep 'src="./js/minisearch.min.e66b5b61.js"' out/README.html
grep 'src="./search-index.27a14f92.js"' out/README.html
grep 'src="./js/search.99d69869.js"' out/README.html

# Nested page references assets with ../ prefix.
grep 'src="../js/minisearch.min.e66b5b61.js"' out/sub/nested.html
grep 'src="../search-index.27a14f92.js"' out/sub/nested.html
grep 'src="../js/search.99d69869.js"' out/sub/nested.html

# No absolute /js/ paths, no fetch of search-index.json.
! grep 'src="/js/' out/README.html
! grep 'src="/js/' out/sub/nested.html
! grep 'search-index\.json' out/js/search.99d69869.js

# Index URLs are relative to the site root, and the script resolves
# them against its own location, so results work wherever the site is
# published: under a URL prefix such as -base names, or from disk.
grep '"url":"README.html"' out/search-index.27a14f92.js
grep '"url":"sub/nested.html"' out/search-index.27a14f92.js
! grep '"url":"/' out/search-index.27a14f92.js
grep 'document.currentScript.src' out/js/search.99d69869.js

# Drafts and SUMMARY.md are not pages, so they are not indexed.
! grep 'Unfinished' out/search-index.27a14f92.js
! grep 'SUMMARY' out/search-index.27a14f92.js

# Without -search, none of these assets are produced.
rm -rf out
md2html -html out2 -html-ext html src
exists out2/README.html
! exists out2/search-index.js
! exists out2/js/search.js

-- src/README.md --
# README

Welcome to the smoke test site.

-- src/SUMMARY.md --
# Summary

- [README](README.md)
- [Nested](sub/nested.md)

-- src/sub/draft.md --
---
title: Unfinished
draft: true
---
Not ready.

-- src/sub/nested.md --
---
title: Nested Page
---
# Nested

Buried deep in a subdirectory.
